detail.command:
set -eu
cd apps/mobile
set +e
npm run typecheck >/tmp/msngr-mobile-tsc-final.log 2>&1
tsc_status=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/msngr-mobile-tsc-final.log
if [ "$tsc_status" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo 'TypeScript check passed.'
elif awk '/error TS/ && ($0 !~ /error TS2307:/ || $0 !~ /(screens|session)\//) { unexpected = 1 } END { exit unexpected }' /tmp/msngr-mobile-tsc-final.log; then
  echo 'TypeScript diagnostics are limited to expected screen/session modules from parallel cards.'
else
  echo 'Unexpected TypeScript diagnostic detected.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
git diff --check
git status --short
